title: fix(runtime): server-composed clone and re-flag bodies drop a stored protection block before the save door
body:
Fixes #23120
Clause-②: no

## What changes

Two runtime doors re-save a body the server composes from a stored row. Both now drop a `protection` block before the body reaches `saveMetaItem`. This follows triage's decision on the card (comment 6136379484): one rule for both doors, no new write face, no `source`.

- `packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts`: `FLOW_CLONE_DROPPED_KEYS` now names `'protection'`. It is spelled the way `PERMISSION_SET_CLONE_DROPPED_KEYS` spells it, because no spec export names the block on its own. The derived spreads are unchanged.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`: the publish-drafts visibility flip builds `{ ...app, _unpublished: false }` as before, then deletes `protection` from that copy only. The app object the read returned is not mutated.

Neither door states a `source` or a write face, so every other save-door gate still judges both bodies. The block binds nothing: only the package loader translates it into a lock (`applyProtection`). Dropping it changes no lock and no verdict.

## Measured

**`FLOW_CLONE_DROPPED_KEYS`.** Before, 9 keys: `_diagnostics`, `_draft` (from `METADATA_READ_DECORATIONS`) and `_lock`, `_lockReason`, `_lockSource`, `_provenance`, `_packageId`, `_packageVersion`, `_lockDocsUrl` (from `Object.keys(MetadataProtectionFields)`). `protection` was in neither source, so the card's premise holds for the flow door. After: the same 9, plus `protection`.

**The re-flag body.** Before: `{ ...app, _unpublished: false }`, where `app` is a row from `getMetaItems({ type: 'app', packageId })`. That read serves a stored row's block as stored (measured below). After: the same body without `protection`.

**Where the block comes from.** `FlowSchema` declares `protection`, so `registerFlow`'s `FlowSchema.parse` keeps it on the flow the engine holds, and `getFlow` returns that object to the clone. A flow the package loader registered arrives already stripped by `applyProtection`. A flow bound from a row stored before the save door's refusal does not.

**Reach, at the public doors, on a real showcase boot** (`bootShowcase` with a database file, through the in-process HTTP app). How a legacy row was made: the flow and the app were saved through the doors without a block, and the block was then written into the stored row's `metadata` JSON with the data engine under the system context. That is the only way such a row can exist now, because the door refuses the block. A cold boot on the same database file then bound the rows through the real path. The script was a one-off under `packages/qa/dogfood/test`, run twice and deleted. It is not part of this diff.

| Step | Before: runtime dist built from source identical to `dc93781c19` for both files | After: runtime dist built at `ee0cbaa494` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `PUT /meta/flow/NAME` with a block (why no new row can carry one) | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` |
| Stored legacy flow row and app row carry the block after the cold boot | yes, yes | yes, yes |
| `GET /automation/NAME` (the engine-held flow) carries the block | yes | yes |
| `POST /automation/LEGACY/clone` | **400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`**, `issues[0].path` is `protection`, 0 rows saved, the copy reads 404 | **200**, 1 row saved, no block, the copy reads 200 |
| Control: `POST /automation/PLAIN/clone` | 200, row saved without a block | 200, row saved without a block |
| `POST /packages/LEGACY_PKG/publish-drafts` | **200 with the save door's refusal under `unhideError`**. The row is still `_unpublished: true` and still carries the block | **200, `unhiddenApps` names the app**. The row is `_unpublished: false` with no block |
| Control: `POST /packages/PLAIN_PKG/publish-drafts` | 200, `unhiddenApps` names the app, row `_unpublished: false` | the same |

The clone's refusal message named a block on `reach23120_legacy_flow_copy`, a flow the admin was creating and had never sent a block for.

## Tests

- New pins, one per door, each with a no-block control:
  - `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-tenant-authored-write.test.ts`. A real protocol over a real `SchemaRegistry`, and the save spied, as the file's other cases do. The source is `FlowSchema.parse` output carrying a block, as the engine binds a stored tenant row. Asserted: 200; the body handed to `saveMetaItem` has no `protection`; nothing else changed; no `source` was stated. Control: a no-block source saves exactly `{ ...definition, name, label, status: 'draft' }`.
  - `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-unpublished-reflag-protection.test.ts` (new). The publish-drafts door over a protocol double whose `getMetaItems` answers the stored rows. Its `objectql` service is a registry only, so it adds no engine double. Asserted: 200; `unhiddenApps`; no `unhideError`; the re-saved body equals the stored row minus `protection`, with `_unpublished: false`; the row the read returned is unmutated. Control: a no-block app re-saves `{ ...stored, _unpublished: false }` exactly.
  - Both spell `protection` literally rather than reading it from the constant, so removing either drop reds its pin.
- Before the fix, at `fb9f991a30`/`477e4f530d` with the pins committed: each block pin red on `expected … to not have property "protection"`, each control green.
- **Ablation**, from the committed fix (`ee0cbaa494`), inside `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode) plus an outer `trap` that restores with `git checkout HEAD --` on the absolute path. The subjects are imported from source by relative path, so no `dist/` leg applies. Predicted before running: each leg reds exactly its own door's block pin, 1 failed / 9 passed.
  - Leg A, `'protection',` deleted from `FLOW_CLONE_DROPPED_KEYS`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `b2579ea10d` to `c551a850dc`. **1 failed / 9 passed**: the flow block pin red, both controls and the re-flag pin green. Restored: blob equals HEAD `b2579ea10d`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
  - Leg B, `delete item.protection;` deleted from the flip: anchor 1 to 0, blob `4c9541ee97` to `660bf46dd2`. **1 failed / 9 passed**: the re-flag block pin red, both controls and the flow pin green. Restored: blob equals HEAD `4c9541ee97`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- At `e3cb0b4deb` (this branch with `origin/main` `e540e7ffb9` merged, dependency closure rebuilt):
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 364 passed (364); Tests 5178 passed, 19 skipped (5197). `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The test layer is held at its ledger, 27 files / 190 errors / 68 signatures. `tsc --listFiles -p tsconfig.test.json` puts both test files in the program (2 of 2, 1414 files), with 0 of the 190 errors in any file this PR touches.

## Gates

At `e3cb0b4deb`, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 64 commands with no paths (5 paths vs merge base `e540e7ffb`). That is identical to the derivation over the claim's paths. Each command ran with its exit code captured before any pipe.

- 63 exited 0 on the first pass.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3) for 8 packages with no `dist/`. Those were built (turbo, all 58 tasks from cache), and the rerun exited 0: "108 published require entry point(s) across 67 package(s) load".
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: "64 derived, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".

**Lint, narrowed.** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 4 changed `.ts` files: 4 linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings, none ignored (`isPathIgnored` false). The changeset `.md` is outside eslint's population (`isPathIgnored` true). `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, as stated in the config itself), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. The full `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- Read, not measured: the other runtime `saveMetaItem` sites (`POST /automation`, `PUT /automation/:name`, the `/meta` dispatcher save) save the caller's own body. A refusal there names a block the caller sent, which is the remedy #23096's changeset documents. In `metadata-protocol`, the server's own re-saves either state a `source` or face (stored migration, duplication, unmanaged import) or, for commit revert/rollback and draft promotion, write rows without going through `saveMetaItem`. So no third server-composed door meets this refusal. Nothing filed.
- A legacy row keeps its bytes until something rewrites it. `GET /meta/flow/NAME` and `GET /automation/NAME` still serve its block (measured above), and a Studio round trip is still refused with the documented remedy. A flip now rewrites an app's row without the block. A clone writes a new row without it and leaves its source row alone.
- Release order: `.changeset/23096-save-door-protection.md` is in `main`'s unreleased stock, and this PR adds `.changeset/23120-server-composed-protection-drop.md` (`@objectstack/runtime` patch). If this lands before the next release is cut, both ship in one release, as triage requires.
